trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum capstone, so leave it for last. Work through the story, side content, collectibles and cleanup lists until the other 54 trophies are on your profile; the platinum unlocks on its own once the final one is earned. Keep a manual save before the endgame so you can return for anything you skipped.
steps: Follow the roadmap phases in order and tick off each trophy as it unlocks.
Finish story, activities, stranger strands and collectibles before the endgame.
Use chapter select or an older save to clean up anything you missed.
Confirm all 54 other trophies are earned, then let the platinum pop.
trophies.tip: Keep a written checklist; the last few percent are usually a single forgotten activity or collectible.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)
Exophase - GTA VI Trophy List (exophase.com)

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the tutorial-style opener that introduces the duo and the basics of moving, driving and following objectives. Play it straight through and the trophy appears at the mission summary; there is nothing optional to hunt for here. It cannot be missed on a normal playthrough.
steps: Start the story from the beginning and follow the on-screen prompts.
Complete each objective in the opening mission without wandering off.
Finish the mission and wait for the results screen.
trophies.tip: Use this mission to get comfortable with the controls; the game autosaves at checkpoints.
sources: PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)
Exophase - GTA VI Trophy List (exophase.com)

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Chapter 1 covers the opening stretch of the story, so simply complete every mission the game puts in front of you until the chapter break. The trophy is story-gated and arrives with the chapter-complete screen. Nothing in this chapter needs to be farmed or revisited.
steps: Play through all Chapter 1 story missions in order.
Follow the main objective markers rather than free-roaming.
Complete the final mission of the chapter and watch for the unlock.
trophies.tip: Chapter trophies are automatic; don't waste time on side content until the chapter closes.
sources: PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)
Exophase - GTA VI Trophy List (exophase.com)

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Chapter 2 expands the map and introduces more of the crew, but the trophy still only asks for the chapter's main missions. Work through the story markers in order and don't leave the chapter's final job sitting in your log. The unlock lands when the chapter wraps up.
steps: Clear every main mission that appears in Chapter 2.
Use the mission log to check for anything still pending.
Finish the chapter finale and let the results screen appear.
trophies.tip: New side activities open here; note them for later but keep the story moving.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)
PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Chapter 3 is the middle act and pushes the crew into bigger jobs across the city. Complete the main mission chain from start to finish; the trophy is tied to the chapter's closing mission, not to any optional content. Keep a save at the chapter break in case you want to revisit earlier decisions.
steps: Follow the Chapter 3 story missions as they unlock.
Complete each job without abandoning it midway.
Finish the chapter's last mission and watch for the unlock.
trophies.tip: Save at the chapter break; it gives you a clean point for later cleanup.
sources: PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)
Exophase - GTA VI Trophy List (exophase.com)

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Chapter 4 is the back half of the campaign and leads directly toward the finale. Play through its mission chain in order and don't skip the quieter character missions; they are still part of the chapter. The trophy appears when the chapter's final mission is complete.
steps: Complete every Chapter 4 story mission in sequence.
Finish the character-focused missions as well as the action jobs.
Reach the chapter's closing mission and complete it.
trophies.tip: This chapter sets up the endgame; keep a manual save before its final mission.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)
PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: This is the last story mission, and it sits behind the endgame point of no return. Make a manual save before you start it so you can return for cleanup, alternate outcomes or any trophy you still need. Finish the mission to earn the gold and, if everything else is done, the platinum.
steps: Create a manual save in a separate slot before launching the finale.
Stock armor, weapons and a fast escape vehicle.
Complete the final mission and let the credits and results play out.
Keep the pre-final save until all cleanup trophies are finished.
trophies.tip: Do not overwrite your pre-finale save; it is your safety net for the whole endgame.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)
PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is one of the early story jobs and is completed as part of normal progression. Follow the mission markers, handle the driving section cleanly and finish the objective; the trophy unlocks at the summary. It is not missable.
steps: Wait for Breakfast Run to appear on the story map.
Complete the driving and combat objectives as prompted.
Finish the mission without abandoning it.
trophies.tip: Stay with your partner and use the handbrake for tight turns.
sources: PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)
Exophase - GTA VI Trophy List (exophase.com)

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a story heist with setup, infiltration and escape phases. Take your time in the stealth section, use cover during the firefight and follow the escape route the game marks. Completing it once is enough and it cannot be skipped.
steps: Start the heist from the story marker.
Clear the setup and infiltration objectives without raising alarms.
Fight through the escape and reach the extraction point.
trophies.tip: Bring extra armor; the final shootout leaves little room to heal.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)
PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a mid-game story mission with a mix of dialogue, travel and action. Follow each character's objective in sequence and don't leave the mission area early. The trophy is awarded on completion and is unmissable.
steps: Launch Child's Play from the story map.
Complete each character's objective in the order shown.
Finish the final action sequence and exit the mission.
trophies.tip: Listen to the dialogue prompts; they often tell you which character to switch to.
sources: PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)
Exophase - GTA VI Trophy List (exophase.com)

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is a story mission built around a public venue and a tightly scripted set piece. Follow the markers, stay close to your partner during the escort sections and finish the chase at the end. The trophy pops with the mission results and cannot be missed.
steps: Start Headliners when it appears on the story map.
Handle the venue objective and keep your partner covered.
Complete the closing chase and escape the area.
trophies.tip: Save your special ability for the final chase rather than the opening firefight.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)
PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown sends you into the airport for a multi-stage operation. Move between cover during the shootouts, watch for the armoured responders and follow the route the game highlights when the alarm escalates. The mission is required, so the trophy follows automatically.
steps: Enter the VCIA area and clear the first group of guards.
Push through the terminal while using cover.
Reach the escape vehicle and lose the pursuit.
trophies.tip: Armored guards take headshots poorly from the front; flank them instead.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)
PlayStationTrophies.org - GTA VI Trophy Guide (playstationtrophies.org)

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is one of the longer story operations, with several combat waves and a vehicle section. Pace yourself, pick up dropped armor between waves and use the marked cover rather than pushing into the open. The trophy is story-gated and arrives at the operation summary.
steps: Begin the operation and clear the first defensive wave.
Advance through each checkpoint while restocking ammo.
Complete the vehicle escape and finish the mission.
trophies.tip: Grab dropped weapons between waves; the later sections throw heavier enemies at you.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)
PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: 100% completion is the long haul: story, side missions, activities, collectibles, properties and the various state-wide checklists all count toward the total. Use the in-game completion menu to see exactly which categories are short and work through them systematically. Leave this for after the credits so nothing gets locked out.
steps: Open the completion checklist and note every incomplete category.
Finish story and side mission content first.
Grind activities, collectibles and property purchases in batches.
Recheck the menu after each batch until it reads 100%.
trophies.tip: Do collectibles by district; it cuts travel time and makes missed items obvious.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)
PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Stunts are the jump, drift and air challenges scattered around Leonida, and the counter is cumulative across the whole save. Find a reliable loop near a stunt-heavy district and repeat it rather than hunting unique locations one by one. A fast bike and a clean landing make the grind much quicker.
steps: Unlock the stunt activity type through story or free-roam prompts.
Pick a dense cluster of ramps and note a repeatable route.
Chain stunts without crashing to keep the combo counter rising.
Track progress in the activity menu until the 250 mark.
trophies.tip: Repeat the same easy ramp instead of travelling; the game counts every attempt.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)
TrueTrophies - GTA VI Walkthrough (truetrophies.com)

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Every distinct activity type in the game needs to be sampled once, from racing and fishing to the arcade and drone events. Open the activities list, work down it and finish at least one round of each entry. You don't need to win, so pick the shortest variant wherever a choice exists.
steps: Open the activities menu and list the available types.
Complete one short round of each type.
Use fast travel between venues to save time.
Confirm every type is ticked in the menu.
trophies.tip: Losing still counts as trying; don't replay an activity just to win it.
sources: PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)
Exophase - GTA VI Trophy List (exophase.com)

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: The Shooting Range has a large set of scored challenges, and each one needs a gold medal. Learn the target order before chasing the time, then repeat each challenge until your run is clean. Accuracy and speed both feed the score, so reload between targets rather than spraying.
steps: Unlock the Shooting Range and read each challenge's gold requirement.
Run every challenge once to learn target placement.
Repeat each one with controlled bursts and quick reloads.
Check the medal board until all entries show gold.
trophies.tip: Aim for headshots on the static targets; they add the most score per second.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)
PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Top Fun drone races run at multiple fixed locations across the state, and you need first place at each one. Learn the course layout on a practice lap, then push the racing line and cut corners where the drone fits. Each venue counts separately, so track which locations are already won.
steps: Find every Top Fun drone race marker on the map.
Practice each course once to learn the checkpoints.
Win the race, then move to the next location.
Mark off venues until every site has a win.
trophies.tip: Drone races reward smooth throttle control; let off early before tight corners.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)
TrueTrophies - GTA VI Walkthrough (truetrophies.com)

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Twenty separate race events have to be won, and duplicates don't count, so spread your wins across different circuits and vehicle classes. Street races are the most forgiving; pick a fast car, learn the route and restart immediately if you fall behind. Keep a list of which races are already won.
steps: Open the race list and note every available event.
Win one race per event, starting with the shortest circuits.
Restart early if you lose the lead rather than finishing out of position.
Track 20 distinct wins before moving on.
trophies.tip: Upgrade one good all-round car and reuse it across most street races.
sources: PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)
Exophase - GTA VI Trophy List (exophase.com)

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal runs a recurring fishing challenge, and you need to out-catch him in a single session. Cast into deeper water, reel in steadily and don't snap the line on a big fish. The challenge can be retried, so a bad start costs you only a few minutes.
steps: Find Cal at his fishing spot and start the challenge.
Cast toward deep water and wait for a strong bite.
Reel with steady tension and land the fish.
Finish with a higher total than Cal.
trophies.tip: Don't reel while the line is red; ease off until the tension drops.
sources: PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)
Exophase - GTA VI Trophy List (exophase.com)

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Arcade cabinets are hidden around the map and each holds a short retro-style game. Pick the easiest cabinet you can find, learn its pattern and play it through to the end screen. You only need one completed game, so don't bother with the harder cabinets.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet in a bar or venue.
Play the game once to learn its patterns.
Continue until the game reaches its ending screen.
trophies.tip: Pick the cabinet nearest your safehouse; you may need a couple of attempts.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)
Exophase - GTA VI Trophy List (exophase.com)

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's strand is a short chain of stranger missions that only opens after the early story chapters. Complete his earlier requests first, then finish the last job in the chain. The trophy is tied to that final mission, not to meeting him.
steps: Find Andy's first mission marker and complete his intro.
Finish each follow-up request in his chain.
Complete his final mission to unlock the trophy.
trophies.tip: Stranger chains pause between missions; advance the story if his marker disappears.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)
PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's missions centre on the waterways, so expect boat work and a few timed deliveries. Clear his earlier jobs before attempting the finale, and keep a boat in good condition for the last run. Finishing his final mission is what triggers the trophy.
steps: Meet Kenton and complete his opening job.
Finish the remaining missions in his chain.
Complete his last mission, including the boat section.
trophies.tip: Steal a faster boat before his timed runs; the starter dinghy is slow.
sources: PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)
Exophase - GTA VI Trophy List (exophase.com)

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's strand is a biker-flavoured chain with a lot of riding and a couple of chase sequences. Work through his early missions, then finish the last one without failing the pursuit. The trophy unlocks on completion of that final job.
steps: Complete Billy's introductory mission.
Work through the rest of his mission chain.
Finish his final mission and escape the pursuit.
trophies.tip: Use a fast motorcycle for his chases; handling matters more than top speed.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)
PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: A strand is a full chain of missions from one stranger, and you need eight complete chains rather than eight individual jobs. The named characters in this list each count as one strand, so finish their chains and add a few of the optional ones. Some strands only appear after certain story chapters, so revisit the map as you progress.
steps: Complete the chains for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret.
Find two more stranger strands in free roam.
Finish every mission in each chain, including the finale.
Check the strangers list until eight strands show complete.
trophies.tip: Finish a strand before starting another; half-done chains don't count.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)
PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's chain is built around supply runs and a few delivery jobs that can go loud. Complete his earlier requests, then handle the final mission carefully; it usually ends in a firefight. The trophy appears once that last job is finished.
steps: Start Randy's chain and complete his first job.
Finish the supply and delivery missions in order.
Complete his final mission and clear the shootout.
trophies.tip: Bring a rifle to the last mission; the range is longer than it looks.
sources: PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)
Exophase - GTA VI Trophy List (exophase.com)

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand mixes vehicle work with a couple of ambush-style fights. Finish his early missions to unlock the finale, then complete the last job without letting the target escape. The trophy is awarded at the mission summary.
steps: Complete Tyrone's opening mission.
Finish the rest of his chain in order.
Complete the final mission and stop the escaping target.
trophies.tip: Block the escape route with your car before the chase starts.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)
Exophase - GTA VI Trophy List (exophase.com)

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditation spots are quiet viewpoints dotted around the state, and each one has to be used once. They show up as small map icons once you are close, so sweep each region and sit at every spot you find. A helicopter makes the tour much faster than driving.
steps: Reveal the map regions by exploring or using a map guide.
Fly or drive to each meditation icon in turn.
Interact with the spot and hold the prompt until it completes.
Check the exploration list until all spots are marked.
trophies.tip: Do these at dawn or dusk; the prompt is easier to see against the skyline.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)
TrueTrophies - GTA VI Walkthrough (truetrophies.com)

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's request is a hunting trip for one specific animal, and it only becomes available after you meet him and finish his intro. Track the animal using the hunting vision, stay downwind and take a clean shot. Deliver the kill to Bret to close the strand and earn the trophy.
steps: Meet Bret and accept his hunting request.
Travel to the marked hunting ground.
Track the unique animal and take it down cleanly.
Return the kill to Bret.
trophies.tip: Use a scoped rifle and aim for a vital shot so the animal doesn't bolt.
sources: PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)
PlayStationTrophies.org - GTA VI Trophy Guide (playstationtrophies.org)

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collectible cards are sold in packs and also found in the world, and a full set is a fixed list of cards. Buy packs from the card shop and trade duplicates, then finish three complete sets. Sets have different sizes, so check which ones are closest to done before spending money.
steps: Find the card shop and buy a few packs to start each set.
Check the set album to see which cards you still need.
Buy or find the missing cards for the cheapest set first.
Complete three full sets and redeem them.
trophies.tip: Finish the smallest set first; it turns a long grind into three short ones.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)
PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It is the in-world social app, and you need to post from a hundred distinct places. Any location counts as long as the app lets you check in there, so combine this with other travel-heavy trophies. Work district by district so you don't lose track of which spots are used.
steps: Open WAiNK It and confirm the check-in prompt works.
Travel to each district and check in at every available location.
Pair the tour with collectibles and meditation spots.
Check the app's counter until it reaches 100.
trophies.tip: Check in at every new place you visit during other trophies; it costs seconds.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)
Exophase - GTA VI Trophy List (exophase.com)

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Challenges are the short skill tests that appear around the map, from timed runs to shooting drills, and fifty of them have to be completed. They stay available after the story, so chip away at them between other tasks. Completing is enough; gold ratings aren't required.
steps: Open the challenges list and sort by type.
Complete the quickest challenge type first.
Use fast travel to move between challenge markers.
Keep going until fifty challenges are marked complete.
trophies.tip: Bronze or silver clears count; don't replay a challenge for a better medal.
sources: PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)
TrueTrophies - GTA VI Walkthrough (truetrophies.com)

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Build a four-star wanted level with your partner in the car, then break line of sight and hide until the stars clear. Tunnels, multi-storey car parks and the storm drains are reliable hiding spots. Save beforehand so a failed escape costs you nothing, and stay together until the level drops.
steps: Bring your partner along and commit crimes until four stars show.
Drive into a tunnel or covered car park to break sightlines.
Switch cars or stay hidden until the wanted level drains.
Confirm the stars are gone with your partner still nearby.
trophies.tip: Change vehicles inside cover; police search the last car they saw.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)
PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Pick three shops close to each other so the run stays short, and rob them in one continuous streak without letting the wanted level reset. Your partner needs to be with you the whole time, so don't split up. Save before the first robbery and park a fast getaway car outside each shop.
steps: Mark three nearby shops and park a fast car outside the first.
Rob the first shop with your partner and leave immediately.
Drive to the next two shops without evading the police.
Finish the third robbery before the wanted level clears.
trophies.tip: Choose shops on the same street; distance is what usually breaks the streak.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)
PlayStationTrophies.org - GTA VI Trophy Guide (playstationtrophies.org)

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Vehicle discovery counts every distinct model you get behind the wheel of, so steal and drive anything unfamiliar. Parking lots, dealerships and the airport are dense with models you may not own. Check the vehicle list to spot the gaps, then hunt those specific models.
steps: Open the vehicle list and note which models are undiscovered.
Sweep parking lots, dealerships and the airport for new cars.
Drive each new model a short distance to register it.
Repeat until the list shows 100 discovered vehicles.
trophies.tip: Boats, bikes and aircraft count too; don't ignore the marina and airfield.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)
Exophase - GTA VI Trophy List (exophase.com)

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus slows time and highlights targets, and you need five kills inside one activation. Start it when a group is already in view and work from the closest enemy outward. Headshots extend your window, so aim carefully rather than firing wildly.
steps: Find a group of at least five enemies in the open.
Activate Combat Focus before the shooting starts.
Take down each enemy with quick, aimed shots.
Get the fifth kill before the ability ends.
trophies.tip: Trigger Focus from cover; standing in the open wastes the slow-motion window.
sources: PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)
Exophase - GTA VI Trophy List (exophase.com)

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: This one requires leaving VCIA by an unconventional route, such as taking a plane or helicopter without going through the terminal. Security tightens after certain story events, so attempt it early or from a manual save. If the airport becomes restricted, reload and try before the escalation.
steps: Save manually before heading to VCIA.
Enter the airfield and reach a parked aircraft.
Take off without using the scheduled departure route.
Clear the airport boundary to trigger the trophy.
trophies.tip: Approach from the perimeter fence; the main terminal is far more heavily guarded.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)
PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Rhinos are the game's armoured vehicles, and this asks you to deal with one in the way the game intends. Provoke a response near a military or restricted site, then either destroy the Rhino or steal it and escape. Save before you engage, then bring explosives and a fast car for the getaway.
steps: Drive to a restricted area where a Rhino is parked or patrolling.
Provoke the crew and get clear of the cannon.
Destroy the Rhino with explosives or hijack it.
Escape the area before reinforcements arrive.
trophies.tip: Shoot the tracks and rear vents; the front armour shrugs off most rounds.
sources: PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)
PlayStationTrophies.org - GTA VI Trophy Guide (playstationtrophies.org)

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Pick a jewelry store that allows a quiet approach, then disable the alarm and take the goods without any guard spotting you. Crouch behind counters, wait for patrols to turn and use suppressed weapons if you need to drop a guard. The trophy fails the moment the alarm or a detection meter fills.
steps: Scout the store and note guard patrol routes.
Disable the alarm and cameras before entering the back room.
Take the merchandise while staying out of sight.
Leave the store without any detection alert.
trophies.tip: If you get spotted, reload the save; a loud robbery won't count.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)
PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Five separate bank vaults have to be robbed and escaped from, and the count is per vault rather than per attempt. Learn one reliable bank route and repeat it, or work through the different branches for variety. Each run ends only when you lose the police and stash the take.
steps: Unlock the bank robbery activity through story progress.
Case a bank and plan the entry, vault and escape route.
Crack the vault, grab the cash and fight out.
Evade the wanted level and bank the money; repeat five times.
trophies.tip: Use the same bank five times if it's reliable; there's no bonus for variety.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)
TrueTrophies - GTA VI Walkthrough (truetrophies.com)

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Armoured trucks run fixed routes and only open under force, so ambush one at a stop rather than chasing it down the highway. Block the road, disable the escort and crack the rear doors, then get clear before the response arrives. Escaping with the cash completes the trophy.
steps: Track an armoured truck route and pick a quiet stop.
Block its path and take out the escort.
Force the rear doors and grab the cargo.
Drive to a hideout and lose the wanted level.
trophies.tip: Robbing one in a tunnel traps the escort and buys you time.
sources: PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)
Exophase - GTA VI Trophy List (exophase.com)

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Every named area of Leonida has to be visited at least once, and the map only reveals them as you get close. Fly a helicopter along the coast and over the interior to sweep large regions quickly, then land in any area that stays greyed out. The exploration menu tracks each region.
steps: Open the map and identify regions that are still fogged.
Fly a helicopter in a grid pattern over each one.
Land or drive into any area that doesn't register.
Repeat until the exploration list is fully ticked.
trophies.tip: Fly at low altitude; some small districts only reveal when you're close to the ground.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)
TrueTrophies - GTA VI Walkthrough (truetrophies.com)

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Each gang runs its own illegal operation, and you need to hit one operation per gang rather than clearing a single gang's whole network. Scout the location first, then go in with enough firepower to handle the guards. Robbing the stash and escaping marks that gang off the list.
steps: Identify each gang's operation location from the map or intel.
Scout the site and plan an entry point.
Clear the guards, take the stash and escape.
Repeat for every gang until each one is ticked.
trophies.tip: Do the weakest gang first to learn the layout pattern these sites share.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)
PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to Ocean Beach and find a bar with an outdoor terrace overlooking the water, then order a cocktail and stay for the view. This is missable because the venue can close or change hands later in the story, so do it early or reload a manual save. Sitting down with the drink is what triggers the trophy.
steps: Save manually before travelling to Ocean Beach.
Find a beachfront bar with a terrace.
Order a cocktail and take a seat facing the ocean.
Stay in the seat until the trophy appears.
trophies.tip: Try the rooftop bars first; the beach-level ones are often crowded.
sources: PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)
Exophase - GTA VI Trophy List (exophase.com)

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: This is a showroom smash-and-grab: get into a dealership, take a car and drive it straight through the front window. Pick a heavy vehicle if you can, since the glass and frames need real force. Escaping the scene with the car completes it.
steps: Enter a vehicle showroom and pick a car.
Start it up and line up with the front display window.
Accelerate through the glass and out onto the street.
Lose the police response to finish.
trophies.tip: Reverse into the window if the car is rear-wheel drive; you get more traction.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)
PlayStationTrophies.org - GTA VI Trophy Guide (playstationtrophies.org)

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and play a full game through to the last frame. The trophy is tied to finishing the game properly, so don't quit out midway. Any score works, which makes this one of the easiest activities on the list.
steps: Locate the Kolt & Associates bowling alley on the map.
Pay for a lane and start a game.
Bowl all ten frames to the end.
Wait for the scoreboard summary to finish.
trophies.tip: Aim slightly right of centre for the pocket; the lane breaks toward the gutter.
sources: PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)
Exophase - GTA VI Trophy List (exophase.com)

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: This unlocks through a partnership activity rather than a single mission, so spend time building the duo's public profile. Take part in the partner-focused activity and finish a full session with a strong result. Doing it after the story gives you the widest choice of venues.
steps: Check the activity list for the partner-specific event.
Complete a full session with your partner.
Aim for a strong score rather than just finishing.
Replay if the trophy doesn't appear on the first result.
trophies.tip: Bring your partner along for other activities first; familiarity helps the score.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)
PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: The game quietly tallies the choices you make during the story, and this trophy tracks that hidden counter across the whole campaign. Play naturally and it will come, but a manual save before major decision points lets you revisit a branch if the counter stalls. There is no single mission that awards it.
steps: Keep a manual save before story decisions with obvious branches.
Play through the campaign and make choices rather than skipping prompts.
Avoid reloading constantly so the tally accumulates.
Let the trophy unlock naturally as the story progresses.
trophies.tip: Don't reload to undo every choice; the counter needs a full playthrough's worth.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)
TrueTrophies - GTA VI Walkthrough (truetrophies.com)

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: This one rewards coming back after a failure, so deliberately fail a repeatable activity once and then succeed on the retry. Arcade games and shooting challenges are the quickest options because a retry is instant. Don't reload the save between attempts or the retry won't register.
steps: Save before starting a repeatable activity.
Fail the first attempt on purpose.
Retry immediately and complete it successfully.
Confirm the trophy pops after the second run.
trophies.tip: Pick an activity with a fast restart button so the retry is genuinely immediate.
sources: PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)
Exophase - GTA VI Trophy List (exophase.com)

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Something strange happens out in the wilds of Leonida, and you have to be there to see it. These events are tied to specific locations and times, so visit the known hotspots at night and wait for the encounter. It stays available after the story, so you can hunt it during cleanup.
steps: Check a map guide for the paranormal event locations.
Travel to a hotspot at night and wait in the area.
Follow any lights, sounds or markers that appear.
Stay until the encounter finishes and the trophy triggers.
trophies.tip: Turn the in-game brightness up; the event is easy to miss in the dark.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)
TrueTrophies - GTA VI Walkthrough (truetrophies.com)

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: A melee drive-by means hitting someone with your vehicle while a passenger swings a melee weapon, so bring your partner along. Drive slowly past a pedestrian or a lone enemy and let the passenger strike as you pass. It works best on a quiet street with plenty of space to line up.
steps: Get a vehicle and have your partner ride along.
Drive to a quiet street with pedestrians or lone enemies.
Slow down and pass close so the melee swing connects.
Confirm the hit registers before driving off.
trophies.tip: Approach at walking pace; at speed the swing whiffs and you just run them over.
sources: PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)
PlayStationTrophies.org - GTA VI Trophy Guide (playstationtrophies.org)

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills come from robberies and heists, and they have to be laundered through your contacts rather than spent directly. Bank your takings, then run laundering jobs until a quarter of a million has been cleaned. The counter is cumulative, so repeated smaller jobs add up.
steps: Collect Marked Bills from robberies and heists.
Open your contacts and start a laundering job.
Complete the job and repeat with the next batch.
Keep going until $250,000 has been laundered.
trophies.tip: Launder after every big score; carrying marked bills risks losing them on a bust.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)
PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Shop spending is tallied across every store in the state, so buy from a mix of clothing, gun and convenience shops rather than one big purchase. Weapon upgrades and clothing are the least wasteful way to hit the total. Money carries over after the story, so this is easy cleanup.
steps: Bank enough cash from story missions and heists.
Visit clothing, gun and convenience stores.
Buy upgrades and outfits you will actually use.
Check the spending counter until it passes $100,000.
trophies.tip: Buy the expensive weapon upgrades first; they count and improve your loadout.
sources: PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)
Exophase - GTA VI Trophy List (exophase.com)

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Garage properties are bought through the in-game property website and each one adds vehicle storage. Save up from heists, then buy the cheapest garages first to spread the cost. All of them have to be owned at the same time, so don't sell one to fund another.
steps: Open the property website and list every garage for sale.
Save enough cash to cover the full set.
Buy the garages one by one, cheapest first.
Confirm every garage shows as owned in the property menu.
trophies.tip: Finish the big heists before buying; the payouts cover most of the set.
sources: PowerPyx - GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)
TrueTrophies - GTA VI Walkthrough (truetrophies.com)

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Scooter Bros is a rental app, and you need to register ten different vehicles through it. Open the app, pick a nearby scooter or bike and complete the registration each time; the same model can be registered at different locations. A short loop around a busy district gets this done quickly.
steps: Install and open the Scooter Bros app.
Find a scooter or bike registered to the service.
Complete the in-app registration for that vehicle.
Repeat at different locations until ten are registered.
trophies.tip: Register one before every other activity you do; the count rises without extra trips.
sources: PSNProfiles - GTA VI Trophy List & Guide (psnprofiles.com)
Exophase - GTA VI Trophy List (exophase.com)
